mapper.select: SELECT id, app_code, config_type, ai_provider, ai_base_url, ai_api_key, ai_model, enabled, note FROM ai_app_model_config WHERE app_code=#{appCode} AND config_type=#{configType} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_app_model_config SET ai_provider=#{aiProvider}, ai_base_url=#{aiBaseUrl}, ai_api_key=CASE WHEN #{aiApiKey} IS NULL OR #{aiApiKey}='' THEN ai_api_key ELSE #{aiApiKey} END, ai_model=#{aiModel}, enabled=#{enabled}, note=#{note}, gmt_modified=NOW() WHERE app_code=#{appCode} AND config_type=#{configType}
